items.name: Bolt and Uber do not exist here
items.body: Bolt does NOT operate anywhere in Albania. Neither does Uber. A 2024 Bolt launch was rumored and never happened. Opening either app returns 'no rides available', permanent, not a glitch. Many published safety guides still tell you to use Bolt here; ignore them.

items.name: Apps to install
items.body: Install Patoko + Clust minimum and register a card in each on wifi before landing.

apps.name: Patoko
apps.why: Typically cheapest (~15–20% under street taxis). English/Italian/Albanian. Any international number, foreign cards.

apps.name: Clust
apps.why: Best nationwide coverage, also works in Sarandë, which matters for Aug 29.

apps.name: Vrapon
apps.why: Largest fleet (~1,500 cars), advance booking, all Albanian cities.

apps.why: Dispatch-style backup. Closer to calling a cab than true ride-hailing.

items.body: Meaningfully better than Morocco. Brush teeth, shower, and wash produce freely; drink bottled.

meta.verdict: Meaningfully better than Morocco. Brush teeth, shower, and wash produce freely; drink bottled.
meta.why: Tirana water is treated to standard from the Bovilla Reservoir, but aging distribution pipes are the last-kilometer variable, and this building is under partial reconstruction.
meta.ice: Fine at real restaurants. Skip at street stalls.
meta.ksamil_note: Bottled for everything. Be more careful with ice, peak-August demand strains coastal systems.

items.name: Crime overview
items.body: One of the easier stops on the route. Violent crime against tourists is extremely rare; the profile resembles Italy or Spain. Albania's violent crime rate sits below Italy's and France's.

meta.verdict: One of the easier stops on the route. Violent crime against tourists is extremely rare; the profile resembles Italy or Spain. Albania's violent crime rate sits below Italy's and France's.
meta.advisory_status: Sources disagree, some list Level 1, others Level 2 (same as France, UK, Germany). Either way, unremarkable.
meta.hospitality: Besa is a real cultural institution, not brochure copy. Expect people to walk you to a place rather than point. Staring from older men is curiosity about a foreigner, not hostility.
meta.top_risk: Traffic, by a wide margin, aggressive drivers, poor sidewalks, scooters on pavements. Crosswalks are advisory.

items.note: One of the easier stops on the route. Violent crime against tourists is extremely rare; the profile resembles Italy or Spain. Albania's violent crime rate sits below Italy's and France's.
